subject.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries

question: Should QQBot intentionally reject prototype-inherited programmatic account credentials after exact-head persistence proof is added?
rationale: The change fixes inconsistent cleanup semantics and does not affect normal file-backed config, but it deliberately removes behavior available to unusual programmatic config objects, so owner intent is needed before accepting that compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept own-property semantics
options.body: After exact-head persistence proof, merge the consistent rule that only explicitly owned QQBot account and secret properties are configuration.

options.title: Preserve inherited programmatic config
options.body: Pause and define a supported compatibility contract for prototype-backed QQBot config before changing resolver and cleanup behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept own-property semantics
recommendation.body: After exact-head persistence proof, merge the consistent rule that only explicitly owned QQBot account and secret properties are configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available history owner for the QQBot bridge and engine configuration architecture being changed.
